description: Read one Graunt catalog packet by id. Returns its title, description, price and whether an account is needed, its seller-declared rights, and its public URL. A free packet that needs no account also returns its files: small text files (CSV, JSON, Markdown, text and similar) in the text, and a short-lived download link for each listed file in metadata.files (at most 100 per fetch; files_not_listed counts the rest). Images, audio and video carry no link and download from the packet's public URL. A video listing also returns metadata.video: its subjects, measured hours, per-hour price with volume tiers, and the seller's declarations.
name: fetch

ai_generation.description: The seller's AI-generation declaration: extent NONE (not AI-generated), PARTIAL (with share_percent and description) or FULL. A seller declaration, not a Graunt finding; absent when the seller has not declared.

delivery_methods.description: How the files reach a buyer, one row per way: the method and the source the files come from (GRAUNT: storage Graunt holds).

files.description: Present when the packet downloads without an account: one entry per listed file (at most 100; files_not_listed counts the rest). inline says how much of the file the text shows (up to 200 KB of text in all); download_url works until download_expires_at. Images, audio and video carry no link here and download from the packet's public URL.

files_not_listed.description: Present when the packet has more files than one fetch lists (100): how many more there are. They download from the packet's public URL.

files_note.description: Why the files could not be returned right now (for example a rate limit), in plain words.

free_access_grant_url.description: Present only when the packet can be taken with no account: POST it for a short-lived grant, then GET the download_url in its response.

seller_hosted.description: Present only on a listing whose files are delivered from the seller's storage after purchase: file count, bytes, media facts, delivery modes and samples. Never a link to a file.

access_period_days.description: Days the buyer can get the files once they are available; the buyer copies the set within them.

delivery_modes.description: How the buyer can receive the files. LINKS: a download link per file.

media.description: Null when the set holds no audio or video. Frame rates are frames per second; clip lengths are whole seconds.

samples.description: Sample files a buyer can look at before buying.

samples_url.description: The public route that lists the samples.

spec_check.description: Files Graunt read at random from the full set and compared with the manifest's media facts, and how many matched. Null when none were read.

total_duration_seconds.description: Seconds of audio and video in the set.

video.description: Present only on a video listing: subjects, the hours Graunt measured, the per-hour price with its volume tiers, and the seller's declarations (people on camera, releases, sublicense), kept apart.

barred_uses.description: Uses no license permits for this footage, whatever else the listing allows. Present when the footage shows people.

camera_views.description: How the footage was shot, from the closed camera-view list; empty when none was given. Filter with camera_view on GET /v1/listings.

measured.description: What Graunt measured from the files; null when it measured none.

eligible_duration_seconds.description: Seconds of video a buyer of the whole listing receives and pays for.

hours.description: The same length in hours, to one decimal place.

per_hour.description: The per-hour price, or null when the listing has a flat price. The seller sets the rate. The volume tier is applied automatically from the hours in the order; there is no code and nothing to request. All amounts are integer cents.

price_cents.description: The listing price, subtotal_cents minus discount_cents: what checkout charges before any sales tax.

tier_applied.description: The tier this listing's hours reach; null when they reach none.

min_hours.description: Hours in the order from which the tier applies.

volume_tiers.description: This listing's volume schedule, lowest tier first: a term of the listing, recorded in every purchase. The seller funds each discount.

min_hours.description: Hours in the order from which the tier applies.

seller_declared.description: The seller's declarations, kept apart from what Graunt measured. Never Graunt's findings.

attestations.description: What the seller declares about the material, recorded as the seller declared it. Graunt does not compute these.

guardian_releases_on_file.description: Whether the releases on file include a parent's or guardian's release for each minor shown.

identifiable_minors.description: Whether anyone under 18 can be identified in the content.

identifiable_minors_age.description: The age identifiable_minors was answered against: 18. A false identifiable_minors counts only with it.

native_resolution.description: The lowest native resolution in the listing.

people_on_camera.description: How people appear: SUBJECT (the footage is about them) or INCIDENTAL (in passing, in a crowd).

person_release_status.description: Releases from the people shown. INCOMPLETE is allowed only when people appear incidentally.

depicts_person.description: Whether the seller says people appear in the footage.

sublicense.description: ONE_CLIENT_PREAUTHORIZED: the buyer may pass the data through to one client, named privately at purchase in sublicense_client, for that client's use within the license; the buyer makes no use of it for itself. The license itself stays non-transferable.

subjects.description: What the footage shows, from the closed video-subject list. Filter with video_subject on GET /v1/listings.

title: Read a Graunt packet
